#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export MUJOCO_GL=egl
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

mkdir -p eval_results

for k in 0.9 0.7 0.5; do
  k_tag=$(echo $k | tr '.' '_')
  echo "=== [$(date)] OpenVLA random pruning seed=43 k=$k ==="
  python -u eval_openvla_libero.py \
    --mode random_prune \
    --k_ratio $k \
    --suite libero_object \
    --num_episodes 50 \
    --seed 43 \
    --output eval_results/openvla_random_prune_k${k_tag}_seed43_object.json \
    2>&1 | tee eval_results/openvla_random_prune_k${k_tag}_seed43_object.log
  echo "=== [$(date)] Done k=$k ==="
done

echo "=== ALL DONE ==="
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress/run_openvla_prune_seed43.sh
